name: Magnetic bending insert with a fixed sensor spine
status: separate prototype design; physical qualification pending

insert.material: same TPU 85A/90A grade and print process as the unmodified control

magnet.field_model_note: Nominal uniform magnetization only; characterize the purchased lot and nearby metal.

readout.reference_role: fifth fixed sensor for common-field observations; not guaranteed ambient-only
readout.multiplexer: TCA9548A, one active channel at a time
readout.die_position_note: Nominal allowance within rev012 Fig26 package/sensitive-spot tolerances; allow approximately +/-0.25 mm including solder height.
readout.nail_option: Reuse the two R1 N0 nail cells and one ADS1115; the bending TPU carries no wires.

carrier.retention: 0.10 mm adhesive transfer tape to the fixed backing; epoxy fillets on the two wire-end board corners and fixed wire strain relief; inspect each bond before loading
carrier.fasteners: Nonmagnetic M3 fasteners; choose length from measured stack and preserve original finger clamping.
